release_note_review.surface: plan mode write allowed by PreToolUse
release_note_review.reason: Plan mode no longer runs a write that a PreToolUse or tool.check hook allowed. Headless already claims read-only plan mode. Response-only does not pass plan mode and has no write tools.

Measured JS, not the GitHub note: from 2.1.299 both natives contain classic.PreToolUse deny mapping to 'this tool input could not be given to a hook that checks it, so the tool was not run' and the result-withheld strings. Absent on 2.1.294 through 2.1.296. selected-control-flow.json binds the 2.1.310 functions and the hop table to the inventory hashes. This does not reverse v2 deny, rewrite, or Stop rules and does not add a stream field.

Headless does not disable slash commands, so a blocking UserPromptSubmit now also stops a slash command's embedded shell. The block outcome is unchanged. Response-only passes --disable-slash-commands, whose help still disables skills and, from 2.1.304, commands.
Both routes use --input-format text, not stream-json input.
The note is a background session leaving safe mode on wake or restart. Response-only disables session persistence and is one shot. Headless does not pass --safe-mode.
The flag is present from 2.1.295 onward. Neither route passes it. Input format help still offers text or stream-json.

Measured JS, not the GitHub note: from 2.1.300 both natives return ok:false / deny when updatedInput has a reserved key ('returned updatedInput with a key starting with' and 'The tool was not run.'). Absent through 2.1.299. selected-control-flow.json binds the 2.1.310 reserved-key path and the hop table to the inventory hashes. Headless keeps the v2 rewrite-recheck. Stream-json required fields are unchanged.

release_note_review.surface: selected stream, permission, and init fields
release_note_review.reason: No release note changes init permissionMode, stream-json help, plan mode, the tool list, safe mode, or slash-command disablement.

claude -p with no permission mode starts in default on third-party providers, with telemetry off, or on a fresh install. Headless passes --permission-mode plan. Response-only already requires init permissionMode default.

subagent_type fork is on by default in claude -p unless CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0. Headless v2 already accepts non-final parent_tool_use_id frames. The Agent tool is not in Read,Glob,Grep. Response-only rejects a non-null parent_tool_use_id and passes an empty tool list plus --disable-slash-commands, so the model cannot start that subagent or a slash fork skill.
At most 12 prompt or agent hooks of one event run at once. Decision rules are unchanged: ok false still blocks.
The note changes Agent-tool child calls. That tool is outside both selected tool sets.
The GitHub release says only bug fixes and reliability improvements. The platform executable digest changed. Wrapper changes are package.json only. Selected help lines and hook markers remain.

release_note_review.surface: plugin subagent continuation after Stop or ended input
release_note_review.reason: The official 2.1.304 note fixes a plugin spawning subagents or rerunning a finished one to continue past Stop, ended input, or --max-turns. Settings-enabled headless can load plugin hooks; absence of Agent alone does not exclude that path. This provider lifecycle tightening preserves the v2 Stop/reentry rules and process force_stop cancellation, adds no adapter operation or subagent-tree completion guarantee, and does not extend the separate Research 226 maximum-turn set.

Help text was corrected to match existing behavior. Stream-json input and output help lines stay byte-identical. --tools still says an empty list disables all tools. --disable-slash-commands now says it disables skills and commands. Response-only already passes that flag. Headless does not.
